title: Calculation Sheet: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Late-Posted Installment Late Charge
content:
**Calculation sheet — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

Since no payment reached the installment within its grace period, the portion that stood when the grace period ended is one full monthly payment.

The late-posted installment late charge is the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment (as the product's late charge schedule gives it for the contract's tier) applied to one monthly payment, rounded to the cent, and that figure is capped at the lower of the product's company maximum late charge and the state maximum late charge recorded on the contract. The percentage is one rate for the contract, applied once to one monthly payment; the charge is booked to the cent and is never below zero.

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Monthly payment | the contract record |
| Late-charge percentage, company maximum late charge | the product's late charge schedule for the contract's tier |
| State maximum late charge | the contract record (set at booking) |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Monthly payment 455.00 dollars, a hypothetical late-charge percentage of 6 percent, a company maximum of 30.00 dollars and a recorded state maximum of 35.00 dollars.

1. 6 percent of 455.00 is 27.30 dollars.
2. The cap is the lower of 30.00 and 35.00, which is 30.00 dollars; 27.30 is within it.
3. The charge is 27.30 dollars.

The portion is one full monthly payment whatever the payment that later satisfied the installment: a payment of 455.00 dollars posted after the grace period and one of 600.00 dollars give the same 455.00 dollar base.
